verdict.rationale: Numeral documents its own exposure capability: you connect sales channels for a free nexus study, it monitors exposure to show where you have tax liability, and it reports nexus status per jurisdiction with thresholds and sales counts. Nothing in the evidence shows a backdated liability analysis with dollar estimates, penalties, or interest per jurisdiction; the penalty mention is only a late-filing guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit historical transaction import for lookback analysis, estimated back-tax liability amounts, penalty and interest estimates per jurisdiction, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can import my historical transactions and see where I already owe — a backdated exposure analysis with estimated liability, penalties, and interest per jurisdiction

citations.quote: You can connect your sales channels and receive a free nexus study with no contract or upfront commitment required.
Continually monitor your business’s exposure in all US and global jurisdictions to identify where you have tax liability.
The account's current nexus position per jurisdiction: whether nexus has been triggered (economic and/or physical), the economic thresholds with current sales and transaction counts
